satel.restart_required: Restart required for changes to take effect.
satel.user_code_hint: Used for control commands. Leave empty to keep the current one.
satel.allow_disarm_tip:
Lets vCLU disarm partitions and clear alarms — from Lua rules, MQTT/Home Assistant, HomeKit, dashboards and MCP bots.

Off by default. Without it, disarm and clearAlarm are hard-blocked in the Go layer — no script, plugin or bot can bypass it.

The panel still verifies the PIN. Enable only if you deliberately want remote disarm: every vCLU control channel will then be able to switch the alarm off.
satel.allow_force_arm_tip:
Allows force arm — the panel arms despite violated zones (open window, door, a zone in alarm).

It weakens protection: bypassed zones stay unmonitored for the whole armed period.

Off by default and blocked in Go, independently of disarm. Enable only if you understand the consequences (e.g. night arming with the bedroom window open).
satel.disarm_warning: with this enabled, anything that can control vCLU objects (MQTT, Home Assistant, HomeKit, MCP bots, dashboards) can disarm the alarm. Keep it off unless you really need remote disarm.
satel.scan_desc: Reads names of all zones, partitions and outputs straight from the panel, so you can pick which ones vCLU should monitor. Takes about 1.5 minutes; meanwhile the alarm state is not refreshed and commands wait for the scan to finish.
satel.scan_requires: Requires a connected panel — configure and restart first.
satel.save_selection_hint: Saves ranges to the configuration — restart required afterwards.
satel.manual_ranges_hint: This is the actual configuration of monitored objects — the selection from the scan above fills it in. Manually: format 1-16,20,25. Saved together with the Connection form.
satel.state_unavailable: Integration is not running or the panel is disconnected.
